nodeIdentity.explanation: KF export flattens package documents and deduplicates by nodeId. 8 raw node row(s) share an id with another row (typically financial_input:* or cross_document:* leaves reused across documents, or authored overlays repeating an inventory node). Dedup keeps one canonical node per id — not silent loss of distinct legal objects with distinct ids.
